game.title: Assassin's Creed III
game.blurb: Open-world historical action game set during the American Revolution, from Ubisoft Montreal, released 2012-10-30. RAWG average playtime: 22 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Twelve sequences in the Animus, plus the present-day missions and the epilogue. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Homestead and Trade
chapters.summary: Settling artisans, crafting inventions, board games, convoys, pelts and almanac pages.

chapters.title: The Aquila and Naval Missions
chapters.summary: Upgrading the Aquila, naval missions and privateer contracts.

chapters.title: Exploration, Clubs and Side Content
chapters.summary: Liberating districts, clubs, recruits, forts, the Oak Island mystery and the progress tracker.

chapters.title: Combat and Stealth
chapters.summary: Muskets, cannons, rope darts, human shields, Jagers and convoy raids.

chapters.title: Aveline's Story
chapters.summary: The second story in the Remastered bundle: Aveline's sequences, persona collectibles, businesses and the bayou.

chapters.title: King Washington: Infamy
chapters.summary: The first episode of the King Washington add-on (marked "TOKW: Infamy"), ending with Benedict Arnold.

chapters.title: King Washington: Betrayal
chapters.summary: The second episode (marked "TOKW: Betrayal"), set in Boston.

chapters.title: King Washington: Redemption
chapters.summary: The third episode (marked "TOKW: Redemption"), set in New York.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Assassin's_Creed_III
Fandom (assassinscreed.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://assassinscreed.fandom.com/wiki/Assassin's_Creed_III
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). The Steam app used is Assassin's Creed III Remastered (911400), the only Assassin's Creed III app in the Steam store list, so it is the one on sale; the original release has no store entry there. Its 84 achievements cover three parts: achievements 1 to 30 ("Complete Aveline's Story", sequences 1 to 8, the Parasol Gun, Bayou Fever) are a second story about Aveline, which StrategyWiki links as "Assassin's Creed III: Liberation Remastered"; 31 to 74 are the main game; 75 to 84 are marked TOKW: Infamy, Betrayal and Redemption, which Fandom's link "Rebellion against King Washington" fits. The Aveline block was placed by name, since its sequence achievements share wording with the main game; two achievements are named "Predator" (one in each part) and were split by description. StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0; its Walkthrough and mission pages (for example "A Dangerous Secret" and "The Benedict Arnold Missions") are linked but not written; only a short Table of Contents subpage exists. assassinscreed.fandom.com answers the API, with 500 or more linked pages (the list was cut off at 500), including "Aveline (DLC)" and "Benedict Arnold (DLC)"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 84 achievements is hidden. RAWG's entry is the 2012 game (id 13305).
